name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 26, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Madrikha Beverly Zarnow of the Humanistic Jewish Congregation of San Diego
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation to Dorothy McCorkel, of the Spay Neuter Action Project (SNAP), declaring February 26th "Spay Day USA" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation declaring February 27th "Blythe Manning Day" in the City of Vista as the Sheriff's First Quarter 2008 Champion of the Community.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
No Parking Zone on Huff Street (CC)
C5.
Highway Safety Improvement Program Grant Application (CC)
C6.
Land Water Conservation Fund Grant Application (CC)
C7.
Transit Oriented Development Grant Application (CDC)
C8.
Unscheduled Vacancy on the Public Arts Commission (CC)
C9.
Operations Funding Advance Agreement (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving and authorizing the execution of Operations Funding Advance Agreement No. 27; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , approving and authorizing the execution of Operations Funding Advance Agreement No. 27.
C10.
Home Program Cooperative Agreement (CC)
C11.
Administering Agency-State Master Agreements for Federal and State Aid Projects (CC)
1.
Adopt the following, authorizing the Mayor to execute the Master Agreements:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Agreement No. 11-5382R with California Department of Transportation (Caltrans); and
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Agreement No. 00101S with Caltrans;
2.
Adopt the following, authorizing the City Manager to sign and execute all future program supplemental agreements:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Program Supplement Agreements to No. 11-5382R; and
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Program Supplement Agreements to Agreement No. 00101; and
3.
Authorize the City Engineer to submit Reimbursement Claims to Caltrans and to implement the provisions of the Program Supplements.
C12.
Gift Limit Adjustment (CC)
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
California Water Supply Challenges (CC)
D2.
Appeal of Traffic Control Decision for Shadowridge Drive at Live Oak Road (CC)
D3.
Public Arts Commission "Kites Over Vista" Approval (CC)
D4.
City Council Goals 2007-2009 Update (CC)
D5.
Fiscal Year 2007/08 Second Quarter Financial Report (CC/BSD)
1.
Receive the report.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Operating Budget for FY 2007/08;
3.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Capital Improvement Program budget for FY 2007/08;
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , amending the Citywide Classification and Compensation Index; and
5.
Approve the Classification Specifications for various positions as listed in Exhibit 11.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
Taxicab Ordinance (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony and introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending and Readopting in its Entirety Chapter 5.80 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Taxicabs."
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
